title: MathCraft
description: This mod adds math-oriented blocks that generate in the world meant to help people practice their math skills!
body: This mod adds several new features! Firstly, there are new number blocks that generate throughout the world that players can collect. The number blocks can be used in tandum with an operator block and an equals block to calculate equations! There are also new mobs that can help the player in combat like wizards that naturally spawn throughtout the world. Last but not least, there are new structures that generate throughout the world that contain number blocks to make collecting all of them easier. This mod is meant for younger players in middle school to help them practice their math skills. Try and collect all of the number blocks! Install this if you want new collectibles in your minecraft world, new mobs that help you defeat enemies, and if you want fun new structures to generate in your world!
